Right page: cropped by the scan edge, only the left edge of one text column is visible. Its lines are fragments.

main_text.p: comprobatam ; tantis rationibus communi- tam ; & nos Apostolicam fatebimur.

5. Fit etiam aliquando, vt Patres traditiones non scriptas nimium videantur extollere. Vt recte intelligantur, æquissimam rem postulabimus. Ita accipiantur Patrum verba, ne sibi ipsis contradicentia posuisse videantur : & quum diuersa dicere videntur, sententia genuina Patrum ex ipsorum verbis difertis agnoscatur, non ex nostris commentis. Hæc monui propter vnum Basilii locum. Nam quæ ex Epiphanio, Tertulliano, Augustino, aliisve adferunt Pontificii, omnia sunt vel de doctrina Scripturæ tradita, vel de ritibus externis, nec attingunt hanc quæstionem. Locus vero Basilii aliquid videtur in speciem continere, quo incauti possunt falli. Et quia Basilii verba acrius vrgent Pontificii, quasi traditionibus suis propensius fauentia, is locus erit nobis accuratius examinandus. Verba sunt huiusmodi: lib.de Spi- ritu S. cap.27{a}Quæ in Ecclesia seruantur, & prædicantur instituta, partim ex conscripta doctrina habe- mus, partim ex Apostolorum traditione in mysterio ad nos delata recepimus: quæ vtrag;[?] parem ad pietatem vim habent. Hæc ille.

Respondemus, hunc locum nihil pro traditionibus Pontificiis facere ; quia loquitur Basilius tantum de externis ritibus. Quod quum obseruasset Chemnitius : Respondet Bellarminus, Basilium non solum ritus quosdam, sed etiam quasdam effentialia referre ; vt confessionem fidei, id est, Symbolum Apostolo- licum,

licum vnctio[?] Hæc ... ftam ... & Sac ... Basili ... bum ... nein ... ipsi P ... lent ... quæ ... num ... Quo ... bolo ... mus ... Eccl ... nife ... to? ... doct ... larm ... doct ... quut ... tam ... quat ... quu ... ferr ... dei, ... net ... de ip ... est q ... loq ... quo ...

page.notes: The right page is cut off at the scan edge; only the left-hand portions of its lines are visible, so the fragments above are incomplete and the fragment list is approximate. The first visible fragment "licum" is the continuation of "Apostolicum" from the left page, and the words after it are truncated. The variant "vtrag;" is followed by a printed mark that I could not read with certainty. A small filled bullet stands in the left margin before "ad nos delata" and is not a letter; it is not transcribed. Printed spelling kept, including "effentialia", "myfterio" and "conscripta".
